MR::transport
Description
This iRule command returns the name and type (virtual or config) of
the transport used to configure the current connection. For example
config /Common/my_transport_config. These values can be used to
generate routes or to set the route of a message.
Syntax
MR
::
transport
Examples
when
MR_EGRESS
{
log
local0.
"sending message via [MR::transport]"
}
